title: line2p control points and intersections in targets (TM3 06 T07)
notes: Questions add the intersections of the two line2p lines (and normals) to targets, so that the crosshair snaps to them (wiki: Dynamic intersection of two line2p objects). The line2p control points use targets as attractors as well; before meclib 2026 10 11 a control point dragged near such an intersection became a glider on it (on a point it moves itself) and stuck at off-grid coordinates. The cases replay the moves of a student in TM3 06 T07.

cases.label: line 1 through C and A, line 2 dragged to A: its start point lands on A (grid), not on the intersection
then line 2's start point dragged away from A: it moves freely
line 2 from (-3,2) to (1,-4), crosshair dragged near the intersection of the lines (-1.5,-0.25): it snaps to it
